verdict.rationale: Activepieces has a built-in AI agent builder and chat-based assistant that lets users describe tasks in plain language ('summarise my unread emails every morning', 'only reply to paying customers') to generate agents/automations with tools and instructions, plus an AI agent that autonomously executes steps with approval gating. This is well documented across product and changelog pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the assistant's real-world reliability and depth (community evidence is about the workflow engine generally, not the AI assistant specifically).
